title: Toxicity of indoxyl sulfate to human T cells
description: Indoxyl sulfate, as one of the protein-bound renal toxin, participate in multiple pathologies of CKD complications, yet its effect on immune cell has not been studied. This study aimed to explore the genome wide expression profile in human peripheral blood T cells under stimulation by indoxyl sulfate.
